public_definitions: The task requires assigning January to a handling route based on its discharge position relative to the monthly average level.
The routing decision must be based on the reported monthly discharge figures shown in the dashboard.
The options are: 'Route January to elevated discharge monitoring', 'Route January to average-band discharge monitoring', or 'Route January to reduced discharge conservation review'.
